title: China Changed Its Degree Programmes. Will Africa Change Its Curriculum?
kicker: THE BUSINESS CLINIC.AFRICA™ / KP THOUGHT LEADERSHIP
deck: The 12,000-programme debate is not about burning certificates. It is about educating for the economies we intend to build.
byline: Kruger Phiri | Founder & Managing Partner, The Business Clinic.Africa™ | 7 October 2026
author: Kruger Phiri

sources.text: China Ministry of Education, "Universities change courses to better reflect nation's needs" (25 October 2024), reporting approximately 12,000 discontinued or suspended programme locations since 2012. https://en.moe.gov.cn/news/media_highlights/202410/t20241025_1159253.html
China Ministry of Education, "MOE releases latest undergraduate program accreditation and approval results" (24 April 2025). https://en.moe.gov.cn/news/press_releases/202504/t20250430_1189218.html
China Ministry of Education, "Action plan for academic discipline adjustment issued" (29 August 2025). https://en.moe.gov.cn/news/press_releases/202509/t20250901_1411338.html
Sichuan University, university-hosted report on proposed 2024 programme changes (22 July 2024). https://www.scu.edu.cn/info/1202/29374.htm

World Bank, "Building Skills, Creating Jobs, and Empowering Africa's Future" (16 March 2026). https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/speech/2026/03/16/building-skills-creating-jobs-and-empowering-africa-s-future
International Labour Organization, Global Employment Trends for Youth 2024: In Figures (16 August 2024). https://www.ilo.org/resource/article/global-employment-trends-youth-2024-figures
United Nations, 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, Targets 4.4, 8.2-8.3 and 9.2. https://sdgs.un.org/2030agenda
African Union, Agenda 2063, Aspiration 1: Well educated citizens, transformed economies and jobs. https://au.int/en/agenda2063/aspirations
African Union, Continental Education Strategy for Africa 2026-2035 (25 June 2025). https://saro.au.int/index.php/en/documents/2025-06-25/continental-education-strategy-africa-2026-2035
African Union, African Continental TVET Strategy 2025-2034 (16 June 2025). https://au.int/en/documents/20250616/african-continental-tvet-strategy-2025-34

World Bank, "Africa's Higher Education Centers of Excellence: Celebrating a decade" (7 April 2025). https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2025/04/07/africa-higher-education-centers-of-excellence-africa-contribution-to-global-research-and-innovation

notes: *The 12,000 figure refers to undergraduate programme offerings discontinued or suspended across institutions over time, not distinct degrees abolished by China. Comparisons with Africa are framed as policy questions rather than unverified continent-wide rankings.*
